title: The current beneath our feet
hook: The town’s old waterworks has lost its rhythm. Nessa’s machines still follow instructions, but somebody has put the stages in the wrong order.

sources.title: Nessa’s maintenance handbook
sources.excerpt: Heating liquid water can produce water vapour, a gas. Cooling vapour can form liquid droplets. Water collected in a tank is liquid. A supply divided in a 1:2 ratio has three equal shares; the first destination gets one share and the second gets two.

aftermath.gardens: The first current reaches the community gardens. New green shoots appear around Tidewheel Mill. Nessa stays to teach the gardeners how to maintain their share.
aftermath.homes: Warm lanterns return to the mill cottages. Families leave lamps in their windows, and Nessa begins a rota so everyone can help maintain the Works.

route.title: The routing engine
route.prompt: Connect the evaporator to the cooling chamber, then the storage tank. Follow the movement of water, not the positions of the switches.
